edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 45,000,000 for the Shares.
2. Closing. Closing shall occur within 45 days of signing.

3. Representations. The Seller represents that (a) the financial statements are accurate, (b) the Seller has no liabilities, contingent or otherwise, except as disclosed in the financial statements or this Agreement, and (c) the Seller is in full compliance with all applicable laws.
4. Officer’s Certificate. At Closing, the Seller shall deliver an officer’s certificate confirming that all Seller representations and warranties remain true and correct as of Closing.

5. Working Capital Adjustment. The Purchase Price shall be adjusted at Closing upward or downward to reflect any excess or shortfall of working capital (as defined in Schedule 1) relative to the target working capital agreed by the parties.
6. Confidentiality. The terms of this Agreement are confidential.
